instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Waste-to-energy facility processing 180,000 tons of municipal solid waste annually, generating 15 MW of baseload electricity. The company is under intense scrutiny regarding volatile carbon pricing mechanisms and requires significant capital expenditure for mandated emission reductions under evolving national regulations.
answers.pastInitiatives: We experimented with a customer self-service portal two years ago after seeing competitors offer similar functionality. We built an MVP with an external agency in 3 months, but customer adoption was disappointing — only 8% of customers created accounts. We did not invest enough in understanding whether our specific customer base actually wanted self-service before building.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has mandated that 25% of revenue should come from products or services that did not exist 3 years ago. This requires us to systematically explore adjacent markets, new customer segments, and alternative monetization models beyond traditional electricity sales.
answers.additionalContext: Preparing for Series A in the next 9 months. We need to articulate a clear, credible innovation strategy that differentiates us from competitors in the eyes of VCs. The narrative must tie our innovation investments directly to defensible competitive advantages and revenue growth projections.
answers.teamSize: The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 20% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests. We have no dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud infrastructure costs.

opportunities.title: Novel Waste Byproduct Gas Conversion
opportunities.rationale: Given the high regulatory environment and low digital maturity, exploring radical technologies that convert residual flue gas into a saleable synthetic fuel or chemical feedstock presents a massive diversification opportunity. This directly addresses the 25% revenue mandate by creating an entirely new product line.

first_actions: Secure internal R&D grant for pilot study (Q1)
Identify two external tech partners specializing in gas-to-chemicals conversion
Develop a detailed feasibility study within 6 weeks
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Consultant fees for regulatory pathway mapping ($20k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful demonstration of 1 ton of synthetic fuel production efficiency.

opportunities.title: Optimized Asset Performance Management (APM)
opportunities.rationale: Implementing smart sensors and predictive maintenance on existing boiler and turbine assets will reduce operational downtime and fuel consumption, providing immediate, measurable cost savings while building a foundation for future digital growth. This is a low-risk way to demonstrate internal efficiency gains.

first_actions: Audit current sensor deployment across three facilities
Select and purchase IoT monitoring package (hardware costs)
Integrate data into an existing dashboard platform
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 8% reduction in unplanned maintenance costs within 12 months.

next_steps.action: Formalize the 'Bold' Innovation Mandate and create a cross-functional steering committee.
Allocate dedicated time for the senior engineer to lead one radical, short-horizon pilot project (e.g., Gas Conversion study).

key_weaknesses: Informal innovation process leading to lack of standardized testing and documentation.
High operational demands constantly interrupting high-level strategic exploration.
Low digital maturity prevents effective utilization of data for diversification modeling.
